subject: Short runway — request for interim keepalive credits while PO clears
messages:
From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@trillium-health.com>, procurement@trillium-health.com
Cc: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Short runway — request for interim keepalive credits while PO clears

Hi Karen / Trillium procurement team,

Quick note following our call this morning — Trillium's pilot is nearing the timer expiration on Tuesday, and I know the PO is in your routing queue and expected to land early next week (thank you for the update). To avoid interrupting the hands-on testing the clinical ops team is doing, would Redwood be able to provision a short-term keepalive credit package while your PO routes?

Proposed, flexible options we can offer immediately:
- 72-hour keepalive credit (up to 50k tokens) — one-off, no additional billing unless PO not received
- 7-day modest credit (up to 200k tokens) tied to an SOW addendum that offsets credit against the first invoice

If procurement needs a formal note from our side describing the terms, I can attach a one-page addendum and a brief usage summary (attached) for your team.

We want to avoid losing the momentum with the clinical trial scripts they're running — small ask and quick to implement. Can you confirm what your procurement team needs to approve a temporary credit?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
Attachments: pilot_usage_summary.csv

From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@trillium-health.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@trillium-health.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Short runway — request for interim keepalive credits while PO clears

Thanks, Camila — and appreciate the outreach.

Procurement is sympathetic but runs on a PO-first model. Rapid answers for you:
1) They will accept a short SOW addendum or a purchase order amendment that references a credit hold, but it still needs a PO number to log (the PO is expected to be issued by Wed 3 Jun).
2) An email from Redwood confirming the credit as a temporary, recoverable advance against the forthcoming invoice would help accelerate legal sign-off.

If you can provide a concise addendum and a formal line-item description for our finance team, procurement can log it as "credit pending PO" and temporarily allow access. Otherwise, they won't open new vendor charges without the PO.

Best,
Karen Liu
Senior Program Manager, Clinical Ops
Trillium Health
On Sun, May 30, 2027 at 09:12 AM camila_reyes@redwood.com wrote:
> Quick note following our call this morning — Trillium's pilot is nearing the timer expiration on Tuesday...

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 14:20:00 -0000
Subject: RE: Short runway — request for interim keepalive credits while PO clears

Camila — thanks for the heads-up and attaching the usage breakdown. I reviewed the HubSpot note (linked below) and the expected PO timing. Two suggested routes we can take that are low-risk and match precedent:

Option A — 72-hour keepalive credit: 50k tokens, automatically applied to account, expires if PO not received within 7 days. Non-refundable and offset against first invoice.

Option B — 7-day bridge credit: 150–200k tokens with an SOW addendum that explicitly states the credit will be reconciled with the initial invoice; requires a signed addendum but no immediate invoice.

For either option I need quick confirmation from Finance/CS to approve (this is typical — lean operational approval, not an exec waiver). Lauren, can you greenlight a 72-hour 50k token credit for Trillium? If yes, I'll draft the one-page addendum and notify procurement. If you prefer Option B, we'll need a signed addendum before issuing credits.

Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/98721 (notes + expected PO date)

-Markus
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 15:40:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Short runway — request for interim keepalive credits while PO clears

Markus / Camila — approve Option A as a one-off customer experience gesture. Conditions below:

- Grant 72-hour keepalive credit of 60,000 tokens (slightly above Camila's ask to cover unexpected spikes).
- Credit will be labeled "Keepalive - DL-98721" in billing and auto-applied to the first invoice; if no PO is received within 10 calendar days, the credit is voided and documented as an internal write-off (no retro invoice to customer).
- Camila to upload the one-page addendum (I can provide a template) to the HubSpot deal and confirm the PO ETA in the deal notes.
- No other concessions tied to this credit; any discounts must be negotiated separately.

Camila — please send the addendum to procurement (Karen) and copy me once uploaded. I'll notify Finance to expect the short-lived credit.

Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_keepalive_terms.pdf
